intro.title: About Raul?
intro.body: Raul Pardeilhan is an international model, actor, director and creative entrepreneur whose work spans film, fashion, visual storytelling and purpose-driven innovation. With more than two decades of experience across Europe, Australia and Asia, he brings together cinematic vision, performance and global creative leadership.

items.q: How can I book you for a photoshoot?
items.a: You can book me by contacting me through the contact form, phone number or by sending me a direct message on my social media. I'd be happy to discuss the details like the type of session, location, and available dates.

items.q: Do you have experience working with different types of fashion or brands?
items.a: Yes, I have worked with a range of brands and photographers, from commercial fashion to editorial and runway. I adapt to various styles and concepts, always looking to collaborate on creative projects that highlight both the clothing and the unique vibe of each brand.

items.q: How many years of experience do you have?
items.a: I have more than 26 years of experience.

about.intro: Raul Pardeilhan is a passionate model, actor, producer, and DJ based in China. With over a decade of experience in front of the camera, he specializes in bringing characters and concepts to life through fashion, film and commercial campaigns.

historyParagraphs: Raul Pardeilhan was born in Buenos Aires, Argentina. He holds an Argentinian and Italian passport, since his family roots are European. In Buenos Aires he finished his studies at the «Instituto Leonardo Da Vinci», oriented toward commercial business.
He then studied for four years at the National University of La Plata (UNLP) in Buenos Aires, majoring in Business Administration.
After receiving a job offer from an Italian company, having started his career as an actor in Buenos Aires, he moved to Milan, where he lived for five years working for top Italian brands.

He has been based in China for the last 10 years. Feeling at home there, he established Shining Tigers Production in Hong Kong, working as a successful actor, model, producer and DJ, collaborating with elite brands and many Fortune 500 companies.

As an international cultural exchange ambassador, he has connected business, media, fashion and entertainment between leading countries such as the USA, Italy, Argentina and China. His mission is to help people and projects shine brighter globally.
As a visionary with extensive experience in the fashion industry, he has recognized the importance of raising awareness about how we consume and produce fashion products.

He has worked in international environments as a professional actor and male model in Italy, France, Germany, Switzerland, the United States, Argentina, Uruguay, Thailand, the Philippines, and for more than nine years in the Chinese and Hong Kong markets, doing fashion productions and cultural and corporate events.
shiningTigersParagraphs: Working with major retailers such as Zara and H&M, our creative approach captures customers' attention with tailor-made live music for each brand, creating the perfect atmosphere for the best possible in-store experience — including opening ceremonies, new collection launches and promotional campaigns in China's biggest city centers, such as Wuhan, Xi'an, Chongqing, Zhuhai, Hong Kong, Macau, Shenzhen, Guangzhou, Zhongshan, Beijing and Shanghai.

Micro-movie for Motivi: Ms. Mo Xiao Qi, a famous Chinese actress and emcee, and Raul Pardeilhan starred in the short film "The Marriage Date" in Rome, directed by renowned Hong Kong director Mr. Qian Guo Wei.
April 2016: Co-producer and partner with the Argentine Embassy for Malbec World Day, held at the Canton Tower in Guangzhou, in charge of the music, dance shows and performances.
June 2016: Co-producer for the 200th anniversary of Argentina's independence, celebrated at the Canton Club in Guangzhou.
